mainEntity.name: What makes a garage space technically livable as an apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage requires upgrading wall insulation, raising or leveling the concrete floor, adding compliant egress openings, and improving sound separation. Standard garage framing often features uninsulated walls, open rafters, and concrete pitched toward the driveway for drainage. To make it a comfortable living suite, workers level the floor, seal moisture barriers, add thick insulation, and install residential drywall. You must also replace the garage vehicle door with an insulated exterior wall that includes standard entry doors and windows large enough for fire safety egress.
acceptedAnswer.description: A livable apartment requires finished and insulated walls, leveled moisture-sealed floors, code-compliant windows for emergency egress, dedicated heating, and full utility connections.
